dedupe_keys.name: nora3 wp offshore wind power dataset

description: The University of Bergen publishes NORA3-WP to describe offshore wind resources and estimated turbine production around the Norwegian continental shelf and neighbouring seas. It derives wind, power and variability statistics from the Norwegian Meteorological Institute NORA3 hindcast. The own README specifies a three-kilometre grid, monthly statistics and hourly wind speed and generated power for selected 6, 10 and 15 MW turbines. The file manifest lists hourly annual files for 1996–2019. NetCDF files are freely available from the NIRD Research Data Archive under CC BY 4.0. Modellers can use the fields for offshore capacity, variability and climate-sensitivity simulations, while data-gem-global-wind-power-tracker provides separate project locations. A caveat is that generated power follows the selected turbine and storm-control assumptions, not measured farm output. Users must also apply the land mask and interpret the method and turbine dimensions correctly. The full archive is about 3.9 TB; only its landing page, short README and file manifest were read.
